@pytest.mark.parametrize("supplied_version", ["authority-v1", None, ""])
def test_append_materializes_prior_only_when_version_is_missing(tmp_path, supplied_version):
    log = EventLog(ObjectStore(tmp_path / "objects"), tmp_path, "authority")
    _, parent = log.append_event(CardEvent(
        type=EventType.CARD_CREATED, card_id="card", realm_id="default",
        author_principal="user:test", author_instance="authority",
        payload={"id": "card", "title": "retained", "updated_at": "prior-v1"},
    ))
    with patch.object(log, "_indexed_entity_snapshot", wraps=log._indexed_entity_snapshot) as prior:
        written, commit = log.append_event(CardEvent(
            type=EventType.CARD_UPDATED, card_id="card", realm_id="default",
            author_principal="user:test", author_instance="authority",
            causal_card_version=supplied_version,
            payload={"summary": "new", "updated_at": "v2"},
        ))
    assert prior.call_count == (0 if supplied_version else 1)
    assert written.causal_card_version == (supplied_version or "prior-v1")
    assert written.causal_parent == parent.hash
    assert written.field_intent == ["summary"]
    assert commit.parent_hashes == [parent.hash]
    assert log.get_event(commit.event_hashes[0]) == written
    assert log.entity_snapshot(commit.hash, "card", "card")["summary"] == "new"


def test_create_with_supplied_version_still_checks_duplicate_before_append(tmp_path):
    log = EventLog(ObjectStore(tmp_path / "objects"), tmp_path, "authority")
    created, parent = log.append_event(CardEvent(
        type=EventType.CARD_CREATED, card_id="card", realm_id="default",
        author_principal="user:test", author_instance="authority",
        payload={"id": "card", "title": "retained"},
    ))
    with patch.object(log, "_indexed_entity_snapshot", wraps=log._indexed_entity_snapshot) as prior:
        with pytest.raises(DuplicateCardCreateError):
            log.append_event(created.model_copy(update={
                "id": "duplicate", "causal_card_version": "supplied",
            }))
    assert prior.call_count == 1
    assert log.get_head("default") == parent.hash
    assert log.index.indexed_head("default") == parent.hash


def test_supplied_version_append_keeps_parent_fence_after_preflight(tmp_path):
    from pa.sync.event_log import DagIndexStaleError

    log = EventLog(ObjectStore(tmp_path / "objects"), tmp_path, "authority")
    def event(identity):
        return CardEvent(
            type=EventType.CARD_CREATED, card_id=identity, realm_id="default",
            author_principal="user:test", author_instance="authority",
            payload={"id": identity, "title": identity},
        )
    log.append_event(event("first"))
    original = log.ensure_indexed
    advanced = []
    def advance_after_preflight(*args, **kwargs):
        result = original(*args, **kwargs)
        if not advanced:
            advanced.append(None)
            _, commit = log.append_event(event("concurrent"))
            advanced[0] = commit.hash
        return result
    with patch.object(log, "ensure_indexed", side_effect=advance_after_preflight):
        with pytest.raises(DagIndexStaleError):
            log.append_event(CardEvent(
                type=EventType.CARD_UPDATED, card_id="first", realm_id="default",
                author_principal="user:test", author_instance="authority",
                causal_card_version="supplied", payload={"title": "must not append"},
            ))
    assert log.get_head("default") == advanced[0]
    assert log.index.indexed_head("default") == advanced[0]
    assert log.entity_snapshot(advanced[0], "card", "first")["title"] == "first"


def _commit(objects: ObjectStore, parent: str | None, event: CardEvent) -> str:
    event_hash = objects.put_json(event.model_dump(mode="json"))
    commit = SyncCommit(
        hash="",
        realm_id="default",
        instance_id="authority",
        parent_hashes=[parent] if parent else [],
        event_hashes=[event_hash],
        author_principal="user:test",
    )
    commit.hash = objects.put_json(commit.model_dump(mode="json"))
    return commit.hash


def test_10k_history_and_concurrent_reads_do_not_reopen_dag_objects(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    objects = ObjectStore(tmp_path / "objects")
    log = EventLog(objects, tmp_path, "authority", cursor_secret="test")
    parent = None
    for index in range(10_020):
        target = index in {7, 10_019}
        card_id = "small-history" if target else f"unrelated-{index}"
        parent = _commit(
            objects,
            parent,
            CardEvent(
                id=f"event-{index}",
                type=EventType.CARD_CREATED,
                realm_id="default",
                card_id=card_id,
                author_principal="user:test",
                author_instance="authority",
                payload={"id": card_id, "title": card_id},
            ),
        )
    assert parent
    log.advance_ref("default", parent, expected_head=None)

    started = time.perf_counter()
    with patch.object(objects, "get", side_effect=AssertionError("object read")):
        page = log.entity_history_page(
            "default", "card", "small-history", limit=10
        )
        with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
            pages = list(
                pool.map(
                    lambda _: log.entity_history_page(
                        "default", "card", "small-history", limit=10
                    ),
                    range(4),
                )
            )
    assert time.perf_counter() - started < 1.0
    assert page["scanned_commits"] == 0
    assert page["index_result"] == "hit"
    assert [len(item["events"]) for item in pages] == [2, 2, 2, 2]


def test_index_rebuild_is_identical_and_append_preflight_is_indexed(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    objects = ObjectStore(tmp_path / "objects")
    log = EventLog(objects, tmp_path, "authority", cursor_secret="test")
    created, first = log.append_event(
        CardEvent(
            type=EventType.CARD_CREATED,
            realm_id="default",
            card_id="card-1",
            author_principal="user:test",
            author_instance="authority",
            payload={"id": "card-1", "title": "first", "updated_at": "v1"},
        )
    )
    before = log.entity_history("default", "card", "card-1")
    cursor_page = log.entity_history_page(
        "default", "card", "card-1", limit=1
    )

    log.index.reset_realm("default")
    assert log.ensure_indexed("default", first.hash)
    assert log.entity_history("default", "card", "card-1") == before
    assert cursor_page["head"] == first.hash

    with patch.object(log, "apply_commit_chain", side_effect=AssertionError("DAG replay")):
        with pytest.raises(DuplicateCardCreateError):
            log.append_event(created.model_copy(update={"id": "duplicate"}))
        event, _commit_result = log.append_event(
            CardEvent(
                type=EventType.CARD_UPDATED,
                realm_id="default",
                card_id="card-1",
                author_principal="user:test",
                author_instance="authority",
                payload={"title": "updated", "updated_at": "v2"},
            )
        )
    assert event.causal_card_version == "v1"


def test_direct_child_index_advance_never_enumerates_indexed_ancestry(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    objects = ObjectStore(tmp_path / "objects")
    log = EventLog(objects, tmp_path, "authority", cursor_secret="test")
    parent, old_objects = None, set()
    for index in range(80):
        event = CardEvent(type=EventType.CARD_CREATED, realm_id="default", card_id=f"old-{index}",
            author_principal="user:test", author_instance="authority",
            payload={"id": f"old-{index}", "title": "retained"})
        parent = _commit(objects, parent, event)
        old_objects.add(parent)
    log.advance_ref("default", parent, expected_head=None)
    projection = CardProjection(tmp_path / "projection.db", log)
    projection.rebuild_from_log("default")
    child = _commit(objects, parent, CardEvent(type=EventType.CARD_CREATED,
        realm_id="default", card_id="new", author_principal="user:test", author_instance="authority",
        payload={"id": "new", "title": "incremental"}))
    original_get = objects.get
    def novel_only(digest):
        assert digest == parent or digest not in old_objects, "reopened retained history"
        return original_get(digest)
    with patch.object(log.index, "ancestors", side_effect=AssertionError("enumerated retained ancestry")), patch.object(
        objects, "get", side_effect=novel_only
    ) as reads:
        result = projection.catch_up_projection("default", child)
        assert result["commits_applied"] == 1
        log.advance_ref("default", child, expected_head=parent)
    assert reads.call_count <= 8
    assert projection.get_projection_head("default") == child
    assert log.index.indexed_head("default") == child
    assert log.entity_snapshot(child, "card", "new")["title"] == "incremental"
    assert len(log.entity_history("default", "card", "old-0")) == 1


def test_imported_fork_reuses_only_reachable_verified_ancestry(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    objects = ObjectStore(tmp_path / "objects")
    log = EventLog(objects, tmp_path, "authority", cursor_secret="test")
    def event(identity):
        return CardEvent(type=EventType.CARD_CREATED, realm_id="default", card_id=identity,
            author_principal="user:test", author_instance="authority",
            payload={"id": identity, "title": identity})
    base, shared = None, set()
    for i in range(80):
        base = _commit(objects, base, event(f"shared-{i}"))
        shared.add(base)
    log.advance_ref("default", base, expected_head=None)
    local = _commit(objects, base, event("local"))
    remote = _commit(objects, base, event("remote"))
    log.advance_ref("default", local, expected_head=base)
    original_get = objects.get
    def novel_only(digest):
        assert digest not in shared, "reopened verified shared history"
        return original_get(digest)
    with patch.object(objects, "get", side_effect=novel_only) as reads:
        ancestry = log._ancestors(remote)
        assert reads.call_count <= 2
        assert ancestry == shared | {remote}
        assert local not in ancestry
        compatible, health = log.compatible_histories(local, remote)
        assert compatible
        assert set(health["common_ancestors"]) == shared
    # The first lookup can observe rebuilding just before another builder
    # publishes a ready head. Neither a ready tip nor an older ancestor is empty.
    original_ancestors = log.index.ancestors
    for raced_head in (local, base):
        first = True
        def became_ready(head):
            nonlocal first
            if first:
                first = False
                return None
            return original_ancestors(head)
        expected = original_ancestors(raced_head)
        with patch.object(log.index, "ancestors", side_effect=became_ready):
            assert log._ancestors(raced_head) == expected
    # A reset forces the original canonical traversal with the same answer.
    log.index.reset_realm("default")
    assert log._ancestors(remote) == ancestry


@pytest.mark.parametrize("edges", [1000, 2000])
def test_recursive_ancestry_work_is_linear_in_visited_edges(tmp_path: Path, edges: int) -> None:
    index = DagIndex(tmp_path / "index.db")
    with index._db() as conn:
        conn.executemany("INSERT INTO commit_parents VALUES(?,?,?,?)",
            [("default", f"c{i}", f"c{i-1}", 0) for i in range(1, edges + 1)])
        instructions = 0
        def progress():
            nonlocal instructions
            instructions += 100
            return 0
        conn.set_progress_handler(progress, 100)
        observation = OperationObservation()
        token = current_observation.set(observation)
        try:
            ancestors = index._ancestor_hashes(conn, "default", f"c{edges}")
        finally:
            current_observation.reset(token)
            conn.set_progress_handler(None, 0)
    assert ancestors == {f"c{i}" for i in range(edges + 1)}
    # Measure SQLite VM work rather than noisy shared-host wall time. A realm
    # scan per frontier node uses millions of instructions at these sizes.
    assert instructions < 100 * (edges + 1)
    assert observation.sqlite_rows == 1
    assert observation.sqlite_aggregate_items == edges + 1
    assert observation.sqlite_aggregate_bytes > edges

    self,
    event: CardEvent,
    *,
    on_commit: Callable[[SyncCommit], None] | None = None,
) -> tuple[CardEvent, SyncCommit]:
    # Potential repair is deliberately outside the event-log/ref critical
    # section. The parent is fenced again after both locks are acquired.
    realm_id = event.realm_id
    prepared_parent = self.get_head(realm_id)
    if prepared_parent:
        self.ensure_indexed(realm_id, prepared_parent)
    prior = (
        self._indexed_entity_snapshot(prepared_parent, "card", event.card_id)
        if prepared_parent and event.card_id
        else None
    )
    with measured_lock(self._lock, name="sync.refs", track_deadline=False):
        with self._refs_file_lock():
            self._load_refs()
            parent = self._refs.get(self.ref_key(realm_id))
            if parent != prepared_parent:
                raise DagIndexStaleError(realm_id, prepared_parent, parent)
            parent_hashes = [parent] if parent else []
            if event.type == EventType.CARD_CREATED and prior is not None:
                raise DuplicateCardCreateError(event.card_id or "", parent)
            event = event.model_copy(
                update={
                    "causal_parent": event.causal_parent or parent,
                    "causal_card_version": event.causal_card_version
                    or (str(prior.get("updated_at")) if prior else None),
                    "field_intent": event.field_intent
                    or sorted(
                        key
                        for key in event.payload
                        if key not in {"id", "realm_id", "updated_at"}
                    ),
                }
            )
            event_data = event.model_dump(mode="json")
            event_hash = self.store.put_json(event_data)

            commit = SyncCommit(
                hash="",
                realm_id=realm_id,
                instance_id=self.instance_id,
                parent_hashes=parent_hashes,
                event_hashes=[event_hash],
                author_principal=event.author_principal,
                timestamp=datetime.now(UTC),
            )
            commit.hash = self.store.put_json(commit.model_dump(mode="json"))

            self._refs[self.ref_key(realm_id)] = commit.hash
            self._save_refs()
            if not self.index.advance_linear(
                realm_id,
                parent,
                commit.hash,
                commit,
                [(event_hash, event)],
                _event_entity,
            ):
                self.index.mark_failed(
                    realm_id, "local append could not fence the indexed parent"
                )

    if on_commit:
        on_commit(commit)

    return event, commit
